data.situation: The next morning, Lin carried the handouts upstairs and put them on the teacher's desk. The tutor wrote cognition on the board. She used the word for the mental processes through which people gain knowledge and understanding. Lin looked at the little map on the second page. It showed a town with a station, a market and a few connecting streets. The tutor asked who could use the drawing to explain an unfamiliar idea. Lin went to the board and copied the little map. She pointed to the station. “I want to draw an analogy between learning a new topic and exploring a new town,” she said. “At first, I know only a few places. As I explore, I find ways to connect them. With a new topic, I begin with what I already know and gradually connect other details.” She drew a line from the station to the market. “What does your model leave out?” the tutor asked. Lin paused with the pen above the map. The drawing had fixed lines, but her understanding could change when she met an idea that did not fit. She added a question beside one street. “This picture helps with connections,” she said. “It does not show every part of cognition. Thinking is more than following a road.” Back at her seat, Lin wrote a note below the map. The comparison worked for connecting familiar points with new details. It could not explain everything about how people think. Jo read the note and asked about a difficult topic from their last class. Lin turned the page towards her. This time, she started with one idea they both understood, and kept the pen ready to change the picture.
data.easySummary: The class discusses cognition. Lin draws an analogy between learning a topic and exploring a town. Her model shows how familiar points connect with new details. She also explains its limit: the picture does not show every part of thinking.
data.easySummaryZh: 课堂讨论认知过程。林在学习话题与探索小镇之间作类比。模型显示熟悉的点怎样与新细节连接，她也说出限度：图画没有展现思考的全部。

transferPrompt.cue: A coach compares learning a new skill with building a path from familiar moves to new ones. Explain the analogy to a beginner, then give one limit: the path picture does not show how tiredness affects a person.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 教练把学习新技能比作从熟悉动作走向新动作的一条路。向初学者解释类比，再指出一个限度：路径图没有展示疲劳如何影响人。
acceptableAnswers: We can draw an analogy between learning a new skill and building a path. Both connect familiar moves with new ones, but the model does not show how tiredness affects a person.
transferPrompt.feedback: Keep the new shared feature and the stated limit; the classroom town is not needed.
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 使用新的共同点和已给定的限度，不必套用课堂小镇。
checks: 换用技能与路径两个比较对象
